coreResponsibilities.name: ChallengeAssessmentContract
coreResponsibilities.reason: Prospective/conditional challenge claims require a declared evaluation criterion/authority, attribution target, condition/horizon/currentness and only the specific capability/outcome property actually identified or bounded. This cannot merge with realized failure or longitudinal mastery without losing claim direction and evidence responsibilities.

coreResponsibilities.name: FailureRecoveryContract
coreResponsibilities.reason: Realized history must be evaluated relative to criterion/scope/horizon; when post-outcome continuation matters, authoritative recovery transitions must remain separate from terminality and query-specific cost/severity. This cannot merge with prospective challenge without collapsing realized nonattainment into conditional difficulty.

coreResponsibilities.name: MasteryClaimContract
coreResponsibilities.reason: Mastery is a stronger longitudinal/scoped inference over frozen SkillProfile under independently anchored criteria and declared probes/currentness/attribution. It cannot merge with challenge without losing the reverse inference direction or with failure without collapsing evidence samples into capability claims.

whyNotTwo: ChallengeAssessment asks how a declared condition relates to capability/outcome under a target scope; MasteryClaim asks what capability claim is supported across declared condition/probe regions. These are dual but not identical inference directions.
FailureRecovery evaluates an observed history and authoritative post-outcome transitions; it remains meaningful even when no SkillProfile/challenge inference is being made.
A single generic EvaluationClaimContract would reduce GDF2 to R29/F8 vocabulary and erase Game-specific anti-collapse responsibilities discovered by A-E.
freezeGuards: Difficulty/Challenge != intrinsic scalar property of content
Challenge claim requires evaluation criterion/authority + attribution target + condition/horizon/currentness scope
Unidentified challenge explanations remain unresolved rather than silently selected
Failure != Error != Punishment != Loss != Setback != Death/GameOver/Reset
Mastery criteria/regions require independent provenance or held-out ProbeTransformation validation
Synthetic-controller mastery/structural evidence != Human mastery/experience evidence
Mastery does not require terminal completion or globally maximal capability
retired: FunctionalDifficultyRelation as a latent named object

reopenConditions.name: Challenge scope failure
reopenConditions.condition: A repeated meaningful Game challenge/difficulty claim cannot be represented as an evaluation/attribution/condition/horizon-bound identified or bounded projection without losing a causal distinction.

reopenConditions.name: Scalar necessity failure
reopenConditions.condition: At least two materially different GameForms require the same privileged intrinsic challenge/difficulty scalar and that scalar predicts counterfactuals not expressible through existing scoped relations/projections.

reopenConditions.name: Failure evaluation failure
reopenConditions.condition: A repeated failure phenomenon cannot be represented as criterion/scope/horizon-relative assessment over authoritative state/history/evaluation without inventing a new semantic coordinate.

reopenConditions.name: Recovery failure
reopenConditions.condition: A repeated continuation/reset/revival/retry phenomenon materially affects failure semantics but cannot be represented through existing Transition/State/History/Authority relations plus an optional recovery-transition view.

reopenConditions.name: Mastery claim failure
reopenConditions.condition: A legitimate Game mastery/capability claim cannot be represented as a scoped inference over frozen SkillProfile with declared attribution/currentness/probes/criterion provenance.

reopenConditions.name: Attribution failure
reopenConditions.condition: Shared/team/synthetic/assistive cases repeatedly require challenge/failure/mastery attribution that cannot be expressed through current target identity/control contribution relations.

reopenConditions.name: Learning boundary failure
reopenConditions.condition: Repeated Game-side learning-opportunity phenomena require a domain responsibility beyond information/distinction exposure + future probe claims and cannot be handed to Human/System learning owners without explanatory loss.

reopenConditions.name: Repeated downstream contradiction
reopenConditions.condition: At least two materially different downstream GameForms repeatedly falsify the same frozen CFM law rather than a derived measurement model, local criterion or owner-specific mechanism.

foundationAudit.reason: All surviving responsibilities unfold into existing Evaluation, Authority/Provenance, Observation, State/Transition/History and GDF1 SkillProfile/SRVS/ProbeTransformation structures.
